About
Engineer by hobby.
Project manager by training.

I’m Rudraksh Patel, a builder and entrepreneur operating at the intersection of engineering and business. I founded AlignX, an autonomous AI platform used by practitioners at Prudential, Kenvue, and NYU, and I build everything from embedded hardware to multiplayer games to production SaaS. Most of it alone, from scratch, shipped.

My ambition is to build and run a technology company that brings genuinely new ideas to industries that haven’t seen them yet: healthcare, real estate, operations management. Every project here is a step in that direction.

Ongoing · Hardware · DIY

WatchPod
iPod Classic Case for Apple Watch · Prototype to Product

A hand designed iPod Classic enclosure for the Apple Watch Series 4. The working prototype uses a 3D printed shell and a foil scroll wheel, built purely to test and validate the click wheel input alongside a watchOS companion app that renders the full iPod UI: click wheel, Now Playing, and all. The final product replaces the foil with a custom PCB and touch pad based on the prototype design.

Earlier · Game Dev · Unity 6

HidenSeek
Multiplayer Mobile Game · iOS & WebGL

5 to 10 player real time hide and seek. Hiders freehand paint their Minecraft style mesh to camouflage against the environment using an eyedropper and brush system. Seekers hunt with server validated paint guns. 29 C# scripts, 100% custom PurrNet networking.

Earlier · Embedded · Hardware

TouchBridge
iPad → PC USB Controller · ESP32-S3

Touch inputs from an iPad travel over WebSocket to an ESP32-S3 that enumerates as a real USB keyboard and mouse. Zero PC software required. The web app is served from the MCU’s own flash, built by a Python step that inlines all assets into a C header, so there is a single binary to flash.

Earlier · AI · ERP Integration

Raven AI
ERP Finance Agent · Microsoft Business Central

An AI finance agent embedded directly in Microsoft Business Central. Interprets natural language queries about invoices, AP/AR, and forecasts, then executes AL scripts to fetch and synthesize live ERP data. Retrieval augmented generation over a custom financial schema.

Ongoing · ML Research

Continuous Learning Research
Catastrophic Forgetting · Neural Networks

Investigating techniques to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in production neural networks. Comparing Elastic Weight Consolidation, Progressive Neural Networks, and replay based methods on sequential task benchmarks. Research driven by real deployment gaps in AlignX’s adaptive agents.
